People around Ben often share different ideas about the airport. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Tom always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Best of all, he learned to surf last summer.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Check the travel advisory before booking.

Ben keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. Ben is saving money to buy a ticket to Toronto. Tom and Ben are preparing a report about the airport. Best of all, a dehydrated meal needs 400ml of boil.

The bus stop has become an important part of daily life. The experience taught Ben more than any book could. Little by little, things began to change. In fact, the cyclist wore a bright yellow jacket.
The airport looked quieter than usual that evening. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
